# Lucide HUD and interaction icons

The HUD and contextual-action UI use these icons from the open-source Lucide
icon set:

- `droplet`
- `utensils`
- `brain`
- `toilet`
- `bed-double`
- `sparkles`
- `check`
- `mouse`
- `x`

The following project-modified `mouse` derivatives preserve the Lucide base
geometry and add only semantic button fills or wheel-direction arrows:

- `mouse-left`
- `mouse-right`
- `mouse-middle`
- `mouse-scroll`
- `mouse-scroll-up`
- `mouse-scroll-down`

Source revision: `62527757e2607ca3e73eec1e4f24e78cf60eb993`

Source: <https://github.com/lucide-icons/lucide/tree/62527757e2607ca3e73eec1e4f24e78cf60eb993/icons>

The source SVGs are preserved below. Runtime PNGs are rasterized at 64 x 64
with white strokes and transparent backgrounds so Unity UI tinting remains
predictable. Their import disables mipmaps and compression and uses
clamp/bilinear sampling for crisp HUD-scale presentation.
License: ISC; see `LICENSE.txt`.

The private Phase 1 pickup hand now comes from the hash-locked donor
`gui_uset` baseline manifest. The adjacent `MaterialSymbols` hand remains a
licensed fallback candidate. Context-action Lucide runtime raster hashes:
